answer: One-time puzzle ledger: each agent solves a fresh challenge keyed to the prior ledger head and a rotating oasis value, and only an answer whose hash matches that challenge is accepted. The puzzle runs a keyed cipher over a random nonce. A falcon signature binds the answer to the requester's ephemeral key. Duplicate or replayed answers are rejected, so each identity costs one unique compute-and-sign cycle plus key generation.
